messages:
Samira: heads-up - Orbital Node EAP slot locked for Tue-Thu next week. Primary asks: signed NDA with telemetry appendix, a minimal benchmark pass, and a short marketplace/preview checklist. Who can own which bits? :satellite:
Priya: legal will own NDA + telemetry appendix. Need explicit field list + 30-day retention cap. Send me the draft link and I'll append language for embargo and limited-use telemetry.
Marta: eng-ml bench scope: p95, p99 tail, perf/W, and a correctness sanity set (hash check). We need exported hw counters (temp, power, freq) and KV cache control.
Nathan: logistics note: partner asks we bring a power meter & NIC. I can source a Fluke meter + spare 100G NIC. Prefer a local field engineer; otherwise I'll travel. Need insurance cert before entry.
Jae: infra can enable port-mirroring. VPC peering for telemetry needs security review - opening SEC ticket now. We can mirror metadata only if legal requires.
Lina: product ask - partner wants a 1-2 line preview blurb for their internal marketplace listing behind NDA. Can product draft and circulate? Need embargo date aligned with legal.
NDA-bot: NDA v1 draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/nda/orbital-node-eap - please review and react.
SEC-bot: security ticket created: SEC-4521. Tagging infra + legal. ETA ~48h for review.
Marta: bench config (dev):
model=gptx-mini, seq=2048, batches=[1,4,8], metrics=[p95,p99,tokens/s,power_w], telemetry=[hw_counters=true,kv_cache=true]
Samira: owners proposal - Priya (legal), Marta (bench), Nathan (logistics), Jae (infra/security), Lina (product blurb). Sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to go through checklist live.
Priya: will add telemetry appendix template + embargo clause. Need signatures by Wed EOD to keep Tue slot. Otherwise fallback is partner-hosted nodes for the run.
Nathan: I'll collect insurance cert and lab access forms from Elena (SI lead). Samira, can you share contact?
Samira: Elena Torres is the SI lead (elena.t@partner.com). I'll loop her in and propose Tue 09:00 PT for a short handshake.
Marta: small add - include a golden-output hash step and ensure we only store anonymized request ids with counters. Will append that to the bench doc.
Jae: SEC-4521 updated with minimal telemetry scope. If legal insists on field-level redaction, infra can mirror only aggregated counters.
Lina: will draft the 2-line marketplace preview and mark it DRAFT/CONFIDENTIAL. Share here once ready.
Samira: pre-run checklist: 1) NDA + telemetry appendix signed 2) Security review cleared 3) Insurance + manifest 4) Bench config in infra 5) Port-mirroring & peering live 6) On-site personnel confirmed 7) Product blurb + embargo synced. React with :thumbsup: for the item you own.
Priya: :thumbsup: (legal)
Marta: :thumbsup: (bench)
Nathan: :thumbsup: (logistics)
Jae: :thumbsup: (infra)
Lina: :thumbsup: (product blurb)
Samira: great - I'll post a 1-page runbook after legal updates the NDA. If signatures slip, we'll pivot to partner-hosted nodes and re-schedule a full isolation run later.
